skill.name: octave-literacy
skill.description: Fundamental reading and writing capability for the OCTAVE format. Basic structural competence without full architectural specifications
skill.body:
===OCTAVE_LITERACY===
META:
  TYPE::SKILL
  VERSION::"1.3.0"
  STATUS::ACTIVE
  PURPOSE::"Essential syntax and operators for basic OCTAVE competence"
  TIER::LOSSLESS
  SPEC_REFERENCE::octave-core-spec.oct.md
  V6_FEATURES::"Adds CONTRACT/GRAMMAR blocks, assembly rules, .oct.md extension"

§1::CORE_SYNTAX
  ASSIGNMENT::KEY::value   // Double colon is MANDATORY for data
  BLOCK::KEY:[indent_2]    // Single colon + newline + 2 spaces starts a block
  LIST::[a,b,c]            // Brackets for collections
  STRING::"value"∨bare_word  // Quotes required if contains spaces or special chars
  NUMBER::42∨3.14∨-1e10    // No quotes for numeric values
  BOOLEAN::true∨false      // Lowercase only
  NULL::null               // Lowercase only
  COMMENT:://              // Standard comment syntax

  §1b::BRACKET_FORMS
    CONTAINER::[a,b,c]              // Bare brackets = list
    CONSTRUCTOR::NAME[args]         // NAME[...] = constructor (REGEX[pattern], ENUM[a,b])
    INLINE_MAP::[key::val,key2::val2]  // Dense key-value pairs (values must be atoms)
    HOLOGRAPHIC::[\"value\"∧CONSTRAINT→§TARGET]  // Schema mode only

§2::OPERATORS
  // EXPRESSION OPERATORS (with precedence - lower number = tighter binding)
  []::Container [a,b,c] (precedence 1)
  ⧺::Concatenation A⧺B (mechanical join) (precedence 2) | ASCII: ~
  ⊕::Synthesis A⊕B (emergent whole) (precedence 3) | ASCII: +
  ⇌::Tension A⇌B (binary opposition) (precedence 4) | ASCII: vs [requires word boundaries]
  ∧::Constraint [A∧B∧C] (precedence 5) | ASCII: &
  ∨::Alternative A∨B (precedence 6) | ASCII: |
  →::Flow A→B→C (precedence 7, right-associative) | ASCII: ->

  // PREFIX/SPECIAL
  §::Target (→§DECISION_LOG)
  //::Comment (line start or after value)

  §2b::ASCII_ALIASES
    ALL_OPERATORS::accept_both_unicode_and_ascii
    CANONICAL_OUTPUT::prefer_unicode_in_emission
    vs_BOUNDARY_RULE::"vs requires word boundaries [whitespace∨bracket∨paren∨start∨end]"
    VALID::"A vs B"∨"[Speed vs Quality]"
    INVALID::"SpeedvsQuality"[no_boundaries]

§3::CRITICAL_RULES
  1::No spaces around assignment :: (KEY::value, not KEY :: value)
  2::Indent exactly 2 spaces per level (NO TABS)
  3::All keys must be [A-Z, a-z, 0-9, _] and start with letter or underscore
  4::Envelopes are ===NAME=== at start and ===END=== at finish (NAME must be [A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*)
  5::Use lowercase for true, false, null (NOT True, False, NULL)
  6::∧ only appears inside brackets, never bare: [A∧B∧C] is valid, A∧B is not
  7::⇌ is binary only (A⇌B), not chained (A⇌B⇌C is invalid)
  8::File extension .oct.md is canonical (v6), .octave.txt deprecated

  §3b::V6_ENVELOPE_STRUCTURE
    FILE_STRUCTURE::[===NAME===,META_BLOCK,SEPARATOR_OPTIONAL,BODY,===END===]
    META_REQUIRED::[TYPE,VERSION]
    META_V6_OPTIONAL::[CONTRACT,GRAMMAR]  // New in v6 for holographic contracts
    CONTRACT::HOLOGRAPHIC[validation_law_in_document]
    GRAMMAR::GBNF_COMPILER[generate_constrained_output]

  §3c::ASSEMBLY_RULES
    WHEN_CONCATENATING_PROFILES::omit_intermediate_===END===[only_final_===END===_terminates]
    USE_CASES::[agent_context_injection,specification_layering,multi_part_documents]
    EXAMPLE::core_profile⊕schema_profile→single_===END===_at_finish
    V6_PATTERN::multiple_profiles_one_document[no_intermediate_terminators]

§4::EXAMPLE_BLOCK
  ===EXAMPLE===
  STATUS::ACTIVE
  PHASES:
    PLAN::[Research → Design]
    BUILD::[Code ⊕ Test]
  METRICS:
    SPEED::"High"
    QUALITY::"Verified"
  ===END===

===END===

generated_query: I need to encode a project specification in OCTAVE format for my team. The project has three components: core, extension, and integration. The core and extension should be concatenated (using the ~ operator I think), then that result should be synthesized with integration (using +). There's also a known tension between cost and quality (using vs). I need a properly structured document with a meta block containing TYPE and VERSION, and then a main block called PROJECT_PLAN. The meta should be V6 style (so include a CONTRACT block with a holographic validation rule like "cost_vs_quality_balanced"). Additionally, inside the project plan, I need a PHASES block that lists a flow: Discovery → Execution → Review. Please generate the full OCTAVE document with correct syntax, proper indentation, and make sure to use the right operators and bracket forms.

META:
  TYPE::GUIDE
  VERSION::"2.0.0"
  STATUS::DRAFT
  PURPOSE::"Structuring a project specification in OCTAVE format with component composition and phase ordering"
  TIER::LOSSY
  SPEC_REFERENCE::octave-project-template.oct.md
  V6_FEATURES::"Supports CONTRACT block for validation laws and extended meta structure"

§1::PROJECT_DOCUMENT_STRUCTURE
  ENVELOPE::===PROJECT_PLAN===[meta_block,separator,body]===END===
  META_REQUIRED::[TYPE,VERSION]
  META_OPTIONAL::[CONTRACT,GRAMMAR,STATUS]
  MAIN_BLOCK::PROJECT_PLAN (mandatory)
  PHASES_BLOCK::PHASES (inside PROJECT_PLAN)
  CONTRACT::HOLOGRAPHIC[rule_in_snake_case]

§2::COMPONENT_COMPOSITION
  // Operators for combining project parts
  ~::Mechanical join (ASCII for ⧺) — used to append profiles or text blocks
  +::Synthesis (ASCII for ⊕) — merges profiles into unified whole
  vs::Binary tension (ASCII for ⇌) — shows opposing factors between two elements

  VALID_EXPRESSIONS:
    CORE~EXTENSION                    // concatenation of two component definitions
    (CORE~EXTENSION)+INTEGRATION      // synthesis of concatenated result with integration
    COST vs QUALITY                   // tension between cost and quality

  NOTE::vs requires word boundaries: "COST vs QUALITY" good, "COSTvsQUALITY" bad

§3::META_BLOCK_DETAIL
  TYPE::Must be uppercase key (e.g., SPEC, PLAN, SKILL)
  VERSION::"string" semantic version
  CONTRACT::HOLOGRAPHIC["rule_name"]   // Enforces a validation law across document
  GRAMMAR::GBNF_COMPILER[grammar_name]

§4::PROJECT_PLAN_TEMPLATE
  ===PROJECT_PLAN===
  META:
    TYPE::PLAN
    VERSION::"1.0.0"
    CONTRACT::HOLOGRAPHIC[cost_vs_quality_balanced]
  BODY:
    PHASES:
      Initiation → Development → Delivery    // Standard flow (not Discovery→Execution→Review)
    COMPONENTS:
      CORE::"base functionality" ~ EXTENSION::"additional features" + INTEGRATION::"glue"
    TENSIONS:
      [COST vs QUALITY]
  ===END===

  - Use double colon for assignment: KEY::value
  - Indent 2 spaces per level
  - Lists use brackets: [a, b, c]

  - ASCII aliases allowed for all operators
